description: This PHP source file defines the ScreenPermissionService class within the OrangeHRM project. It manages the retrieval and handling of screen permission data, interfacing with data access objects (DAOs) to determine user permissions for specific modules and actions within the HRM system.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing screen permissions in the HRM system, including retrieving permissions based on user roles and modules, and interfacing with DAOs to access screen data.

methods.name: getScreenDao
methods.description: Retrieves the ScreenDao object, initializing it if it hasn't been instantiated yet.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionDao
methods.description: Retrieves the ScreenPermissionDao object, initializing it if it hasn't been instantiated yet.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Fetches the permissions for a given module and action URL for specified roles. If no permissions are found, defaults to granting or denying all based on screen existence.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the Screen entity for a given module and action URL.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the current module and screen context based on the application's state.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Returns the current Screen entity based on the current module and screen context.
